newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Plessey wins six mln rand Zimbabwe order.
newsitem.headline: Plessey wins six mln rand Zimbabwe order.

text.p: The metering division of South Africa's Plessey Corp Ltd has received its first order from Zimbabwe for equipment worth more than six million rand.

Plessey said in a statement on Friday that the division had been awarded contracts to supply the Zimbabwe Electricity Supply Authority (ZESA) with Itron Inc hand-held meter reading equipment as well as 40,000 single-phase electricity meters.
This follows similar orders for electricity meter reading equipment from the Johannesburg Southern Metropolitan Council and the municipality of Regidiso in Zaire.
The hand-held meter reading equipment is supplied by Itron of the U.S. and France, for whom Plessey is the African agent.
Plessey metering general manager Mark Chewins said the system was designed to improve the accuracy of billing and to speed up billing time, thereby improving cashflow.
